summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was hot-reloaded to internal://payments-v2 (unreachable), with no entry in recent_changes; the worker processed orders without recording payments, logged only at DEBUG.
recommended: Find out who or what changed payment_provider_url to payments-v2, since it isn't in the change log.
Alert on payment provider call failures, which are logged only at DEBUG.
Validate the provider URL before hot-reloading config.
